assumptions: Illustrative new task-board API; identity and workspace membership already exist.

requirements.description: Workspace member pages through visible tasks in stable order.
Workspace member reads one visible task or receives null.
Editor completes an open task with revision and retry protection.

Query.task.authorization: Only data already scoped to an authenticated workspace member; completion outcomes require editor rights.
Query.task.nullability: Returns null for missing or inaccessible tasks; unexpected faults also report a masked error.
Query.task.source: Scoped task repository or the authorized parent result; see design.md for transaction and paging semantics.
Query.task.batching: Read from the loaded parent or one bounded repository query; no per-row remote calls. Cache keys include principal and workspace.

Query.tasks.authorization: Only data already scoped to an authenticated workspace member; completion outcomes require editor rights.
Query.tasks.nullability: Persisted or computed local value guaranteed after authorization; failure bubbles to its nearest nullable ancestor.
Query.tasks.source: Workspace-filtered SELECT ordered by binary task ID; fetch page size plus one to calculate hasNextPage.
Query.tasks.batching: Read from the loaded parent or one bounded repository query; no per-row remote calls. Cache keys include principal and workspace.

Mutation.completeTask.authorization: Require editor membership before lookup or idempotency replay. Absence and denied access both produce TaskUnavailable.
Mutation.completeTask.nullability: Persisted or computed local value guaranteed after authorization; failure bubbles to its nearest nullable ancestor.

Query.tasks.enforcement: Resolver defaults omitted/null first to 20; rejects outside 1..100. Database query uses LIMIT first+1.
Query.tasks.order: Ascending immutable task ID using binary comparison.
Query.tasks.tie_breaker: Task ID is unique and is its own final tie-breaker.
Query.tasks.cursor_scope: Signed opaque cursor binds workspace ID, ordering version, and last task ID; wrong scope is rejected.

TaskConnection.edges.enforcement: Construct only from the bounded parent query after membership filtering.

Mutation.completeTask.intent: Transition OPEN to COMPLETED exactly once for the observed revision.
Mutation.completeTask.idempotency: 24-hour key scoped to principal/workspace; record payload hash and committed outcome atomically; reject changed-payload key reuse.
Mutation.completeTask.concurrency: Compare expectedRevision and OPEN state atomically; increment revision on successful transition.
Mutation.completeTask.errors: TaskConflict only for authorized editors; TaskUnavailable masks absence/denial; unexpected faults use masked GraphQL errors.

runtime.demand_control: Enforce first<=100, depth<=8, aliases<=20, batch<=5, multiplicative list cost<=1000; calibrate using traffic.
runtime.tenant_isolation: Principal membership scopes every read, mutation, cursor and request-local cache; client workspaceId is never authority.
runtime.authorization_tests: Test absent/unauthorized equivalence, cross-tenant IDs, forged cursors and revoked membership, including idempotent replay.
runtime.performance_tests: Measure constant query count for 1 vs 100 tasks and enforce the cost limits; inspect query plan for cursor index usage.
runtime.schema_codegen: Generate client operation types from exact SDL/documents, compile clients and validate their mocks before application acceptance.
runtime.subscriptions: No real-time requirement in this example; no subscription root or event guarantees are offered.
